scope: Every topic shown as Upcoming in NCERT, AP and Telangana before this review. Published catalog lessons only.

reviews.title: Exploring Geometric Themes: Fractals and Solid Views
reviews.rationale: Orthographic Views and Nets of Solids cover solid views. A dedicated Sierpinski/fractal lesson is still missing.

reviews.title: Basic Proportionality Theorem and Converse
reviews.rationale: Dilation does not teach BPT and its converse proof.

reviews.title: AA, SSS, and SAS Similarity Criteria
reviews.rationale: Published congruence lessons and dilation do not teach the AA/SSS/SAS similarity criteria.

reviews.title: Areas of Similar Triangles
reviews.rationale: Dilation lesson 241 explicitly compares original/image triangle areas and teaches area scale factor k².

reviews.title: Composite Circle Regions
reviews.rationale: No published lesson covers composite circular-region calculations.

reviews.title: Conversion and Recasting of Solids
reviews.rationale: Combined solids and volume computation do not teach recasting and volume conservation.

reviews.title: Mode of Grouped Data
reviews.rationale: The existing Mode lesson covers raw data, not the grouped-mode formula.

reviews.title: Squares and triangular numbers
reviews.rationale: The editable polynomial sequence generator handles triangular and square sequences.

reviews.title: Taxicab numbers and Ramanujan's 1729
reviews.rationale: No published lesson teaches taxicab numbers or the two cube decompositions of 1729.

reviews.title: Cubes as sums of consecutive odd numbers
reviews.rationale: No published lesson teaches the cube-as-sums-of-odd-numbers identity.

reviews.title: Successive differences of square and cube sequences
reviews.rationale: The sequence generator exposes first and second differences for editable polynomial sequences.

reviews.title: History of square and cube computation
reviews.rationale: The powers/root lessons do not teach the historical development of square/cube computation.
